title: Wren and the Inheritance
author: Jonah Oyelaran
blurb: Ines Fairweather, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
